newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish securities turnover rose in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Danish securities turnover rose in 1996.

text.p: The turnover of bonds traded on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange rose to 6,661 billion crowns in 1996 from 5,981 billion in 1995 the exchange said in a statement after the close of business on Monday, the year's last trading day.
Share turnover in 1996 was 217 billion crowns, up from 157 billion the year before, it said.
A total of 613,000 futures and options contracts were traded over the year just ended, compared with 597,000 during the previous 12 months, it added.
The KFX top 20 index rose 28 percent over the year.
The all-share index rose by 29 percent.

Shipping shares fared best. The shipping index rose 41 percent, largely due to the constituent shares of A.P. Moeller, which showed a 50 percent gain over the year. Industrials rose 33 percent and the banking sector rose 20 percent.
